text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos was looking unwell,
so I took her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainy.
I won't like it if you don't stay right here until I fall asleep, okay?"
choice_data_list: You're okay, so don't worry and get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
――... Huh?
I thought I was sleeping in the nurse's office...
âFound you, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Running away won't do, you know.
Come now, accept your proof of fellowship already, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Crown, Dia...?
What's wrong? You two seem... kinda off."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Good girl, Vivlos...
Now, put these sunglasses on—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Put on the badge of the
"Anti-Telepathy Black Sunglasses Party"!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: N-No way, even big sis...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: N-No wayyyy!

text_block_list.name: Black Glasses Party Members
text_block_list.text:
"Sunglasses are justice! Sunglasses are salvation!"
"Sunglasses should be mandatory for all living beings...!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Did I somehow manage to lose them?
What on earth was that just now――
Fufufu, everything is going according to my plan...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Wait... Is that voice...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Now put on your sunglasses, Vivlos.
For the sake of my utopia, where no one makes eye contact!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I've always thought... it's terrifying to interact with others.
Making eye contact and being spoken to is so scary...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided! I will force everyone in the world
to wear sunglasses, creating an ideal world where
no one has to make eye contact with anyone—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sunglasses for everyone in the whole world...?
That's... that's just—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Isn't this super awesome?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You never match outfits with us,
Cheva-chi, so I'm so happy!
Let's all go on a sunglasses date together♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wait... H-Hold on a sec...
That's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♡ I love you so much, Cheval-chi♡
You promised we'd go on a date, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie, listen, listen~!
I had the most adorbs dream about Cheval-chi♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm full of energy!
I'm gonna go on a date with Cheval-chi♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Vivlos leapt out of bed, full of energy. It seems her body is thoroughly well-rested!
